stories.headline: Cricket Legend Slams India Coach for Telling Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to 'Bide His Time'
stories.what: A cricket legend has publicly criticised India's head coach for suggesting that teenage sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi should be patient and wait his turn for a regular place in the team. The comments have reignited a heated debate about how India should handle one of its most exciting young talents. The criticism reflects broader frustration among former players and fans about the management of Sooryavanshi's rapid rise in Indian cricket.
stories.lens: How India manages its most exciting young cricketing talent directly affects the next generation of Indian cricket — getting it wrong risks stunting a once-in-a-generation player's development.
stories.article:
A prominent cricket legend has publicly taken aim at India's head coach, criticising the suggestion that prodigious youngster Vaibhav Sooryavanshi should 'bide his time' rather than be given an extended and immediate run in the national setup. The sharp rebuke, reported by News18, signals growing unease among former players about how the team management is handling the teenage sensation.

Sooryavanshi burst onto the international scene and quickly captured the imagination of Indian cricket fans with his fearless batting approach. His emergence has raised difficult questions for the selectors and coaching staff about how to balance the claims of experienced players with the need to nurture and back a rare young talent.

The coaching staff's apparent position — that Sooryavanshi must wait and prove himself further before cementing his place — has drawn sharp pushback. The unnamed cricket legend's intervention adds significant weight to the argument that the youngster should be given a longer, uninterrupted run in the team rather than being managed cautiously from the sidelines.

The debate sits alongside a separate but related controversy over Sanju Samson's place in the team, with former India stars also speaking up in defence of Samson amid questions about whether Sooryavanshi should replace him. The dual debate underscores the difficult selection decisions confronting India's cricket establishment as it seeks to balance youth and experience.
key_facts: Cricket legend publicly criticises India head coach
Debate centres on Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's place in India team
Coach reportedly advised Sooryavanshi to 'bide his time'

stories.headline: 'Why Is Everyone Pointing a Gun at Me?' — Ex-India Star Defends Sanju Samson
stories.what: A former India cricketer has come out in strong defence of wicketkeeper-batter Sanju Samson, suggesting Samson must be feeling unfairly targeted amid intense public debate about his place in the Indian team. The ex-player's comments reflect growing sympathy for Samson, who has faced scrutiny over whether he should be dropped to accommodate younger talents. The debate has polarised fans and former players in equal measure.
stories.lens: The Sanju Samson selection debate touches every Indian cricket fan — how the team manages experienced but inconsistent players versus emerging stars shapes the team's identity for years to come.
stories.article:
A former India cricketer has stepped forward to defend Sanju Samson, voicing empathy for the wicketkeeper-batter who has found himself at the centre of a fierce selection controversy. The ex-star suggested Samson must be wondering why he is being singled out for criticism when others are not held to the same standard, framing the debate as unfair on the Kerala dasher.

Samson has long been one of Indian cricket's most debated figures — talented and explosive when at his best, but often on the fringes of the first-choice lineup. The emergence of Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has intensified questions about whether Samson's spot in the team is secure, with some voices calling for the teenager to be given Samson's place.

The former India star's defence of Samson adds a new dimension to an already complex selection conversation. Describing Samson as 'fabulous', the ex-cricketer argued that the wicketkeeper-batter had earned his place in the side and should not be casually displaced, warning against a rush to judgement driven by the excitement around Sooryavanshi.

The twin controversies — over Sooryavanshi's management and Samson's future — reflect the wider pressure on India's selectors as the team navigates a generational transition. Both debates are likely to intensify ahead of the Sri Lanka tour and other upcoming assignments.
key_facts: Former India star defends Sanju Samson's place in the team
Samson described as 'fabulous' by ex-cricketer
Debate linked to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's emergence

stories.headline: Abhishek Sharma Earns Massive Praise From Ex-India Star After Impressive Showing
stories.what: Indian batter Abhishek Sharma has received glowing praise from a former India cricketer, who affectionately called him 'Our Old Boss Baby' — a nod to the youngster's composed, authoritative style despite his age. The praise follows an impressive performance that has cemented Sharma's status as one of India's most watchable young batters. The endorsement from an ex-India star adds to the growing chorus of support for Sharma's continued inclusion in the national side.
stories.lens: Abhishek Sharma's rise is a bright spot for Indian cricket's batting pipeline, and backing from former stars signals he is increasingly seen as a long-term fixture rather than a fringe player.
stories.article:
Abhishek Sharma has drawn effusive praise from a former India cricketer, who branded the young left-hander 'Our Old Boss Baby' — a tribute that captures both Sharma's youthfulness and his surprisingly authoritative presence at the crease. The compliment, reported by NDTV Sports, reflects the growing appreciation for Sharma's ability to perform on the big stage without appearing overawed.

Sharma has emerged as one of India's most exciting batting prospects in recent times, combining natural aggression with a maturity beyond his years. His recent performances have caught the eye of fans, commentators, and former players alike, building a case for his regular inclusion in India's white-ball setup.

The former India star's praise is significant because it comes at a time when Indian cricket is engaged in intense debates about youth versus experience in the selection process. While some youngsters find themselves at the centre of controversy — as with Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Sanju Samson — Sharma's rise appears to have generated a more straightforward consensus of support.

As India prepares for upcoming series, Abhishek Sharma's form and the goodwill he has generated among the cricketing fraternity make him one of the more settled names in an otherwise fluid batting lineup conversation.
key_facts: Abhishek Sharma praised as 'Our Old Boss Baby' by ex-India star
Praise follows an impressive batting performance
Sharma seen as a rising fixture in India's white-ball setup

stories.headline: Ireland's Jai Moondra Earns European T20 League Berth After Heroics Against India
stories.what: Jai Moondra, an Irish cricketer of Indian origin, has been rewarded for his standout performance against India with a berth in the European T20 League. Moondra's heroics in the match against India brought him to wider attention and now earn him a prized spot in a European franchise competition. His selection highlights cricket's growing global reach and the increasing number of players of Indian heritage making their mark in associate cricket nations.
stories.lens: Moondra's story — an India-origin cricketer starring for Ireland and now earning a T20 league contract — captures the fascinating globalisation of cricket and what it means for how the sport is spreading beyond traditional powerhouses.
stories.article:
Jai Moondra, Ireland's Indian-origin cricketer, has been rewarded for his memorable performance against India with selection for the European T20 League. The recognition, reported by India Today, follows Moondra's eye-catching showing in Ireland's clash with India, which announced him as a player of genuine quality capable of performing on the biggest stages.

Moondra's journey is one of cricket's more compelling modern stories. Of Indian heritage but representing Ireland, he has become a symbol of the sport's expanding global footprint, with players of South Asian origin increasingly making significant contributions for associate cricket nations across Europe and beyond.

His European T20 League berth is a direct consequence of the attention his India performance generated. T20 franchise leagues have become a crucial pathway for talented cricketers outside the traditional Test-playing nations to showcase their skills and build professional careers, and Moondra's inclusion is a testament to how performances on the international stage can rapidly open doors.

For Indian cricket fans, the Moondra story carries a particular resonance — a player who might once have been part of India's domestic system instead found his stage in Dublin, and is now being rewarded accordingly on the continental circuit.
key_facts: Jai Moondra selected for European T20 League
Selection follows his heroics against India for Ireland
Moondra is an Irish cricketer of Indian origin

stories.headline: India to Tour Sri Lanka for Test Series After 9-Year Gap
stories.what: India will travel to Sri Lanka for a Test match series, marking the first such tour in nine years. The series represents a significant return to a venue where India has historically had memorable cricketing encounters. The tour schedule has been confirmed and is generating considerable anticipation among fans and selectors alike as India looks to maintain its momentum in the longest format.
stories.lens: For Indian cricket fans, a Test tour of Sri Lanka after nine years is a rare chance to watch the national side play red-ball cricket in a country that has produced some of the most memorable India away victories in recent memory.
stories.article:
India will tour Sri Lanka for a Test match series, ending a nine-year gap in bilateral Test cricket between the two nations. The announcement, confirmed by The Indian Express, marks a significant moment in the cricketing calendar, bringing two of Asia's most storied cricketing nations back together in the longest format of the game.

The last time India played a Test series in Sri Lanka was nearly a decade ago, making this tour a significant occasion for fans of red-ball cricket on both sides. Over that period, the two teams have met in white-ball formats, but Test cricket between them has been conspicuously absent.

For India, the tour arrives at an interesting juncture. The team has been juggling selection questions and squad balance across formats, and a Test series in Sri Lanka will serve as both an opportunity and a test of character. Sri Lanka, playing at home, will be looking to reassert themselves in conditions they know well.

Cricbuzz has also published the full India tour of Sri Lanka 2026 schedule, confirming the fixture details are in place. The tour is expected to generate significant attention as Test cricket in Asia continues to draw large audiences and fierce competition between neighbouring cricketing powerhouses.
key_facts: First India Test tour of Sri Lanka in 9 years
Tour schedule confirmed for 2026
Reported by The Indian Express and Cricbuzz

stories.headline: 'Ashamed': Homebound cinematographer apologises a year after sexual misconduct allegations
stories.what: A cinematographer who has been confined to home following sexual misconduct allegations has issued a public apology approximately a year after the accusations first surfaced. The apology, described as coming from a place of shame, marks the latest development in a case that drew attention within the Indian film industry. The individual has not named those they wronged nor outlined specific steps toward accountability.
stories.lens: Public apologies from accused industry figures — arriving months or years later, with those who alleged misconduct still waiting for formal accountability — remain a fraught test of whether the entertainment industry's reckoning with harassment is real or performative.
stories.article:
A cinematographer facing sexual misconduct allegations has issued a public apology roughly a year after the accusations became public, describing himself as 'ashamed' in a statement that has drawn renewed attention to the case. The apology comes after a period in which the individual has reportedly remained homebound, effectively sidelined from professional work in the Indian film industry.

The timing of the apology — more than a year after the allegations surfaced — has prompted questions about its sincerity and purpose. Critics of such delayed public statements often note that they arrive when the news cycle has quietened, rather than at a moment of genuine accountability or legal resolution. Those who alleged misconduct have not, as yet, been publicly centred in the statement.

The Indian film industry has grappled since the #MeToo movement with how to handle accused professionals — whether to impose lasting consequences, allow quiet rehabilitation, or wait for legal processes to conclude. Cases involving behind-the-camera crew, such as cinematographers, often receive less sustained attention than those involving actors or directors, even when the allegations are serious.

The apology is unlikely to settle the matter cleanly. It raises the question of what comes next: whether the individual returns to professional work, whether any formal process has been or will be undertaken, and whether the film industry's informal mechanisms of accountability are sufficient. The Indian Express report signals that this story remains unresolved.
key_facts: Cinematographer apologises approximately one year after sexual misconduct allegations
Describes himself as 'ashamed' in the public statement
Has been homebound since the allegations emerged

stories.headline: Rajkumar Hirani reveals Ranbir Kapoor came for Sanju shoot at 3 am with 'no entourage'
stories.what: Filmmaker Rajkumar Hirani has revealed that Ranbir Kapoor showed up for a Sanju shoot at 3 am entirely without an entourage, a detail Hirani shared as a mark of the actor's professionalism and dedication. The anecdote has been shared publicly, offering a rare behind-the-scenes glimpse of the making of the 2018 biographical film on Sanjay Dutt. Sanju went on to become one of the biggest Bollywood hits of that year.
stories.lens: Hirani's account counters the star-system stereotype and adds to the growing narrative around Ranbir Kapoor's reputation as a serious, no-fuss actor in an industry often defined by its entourages.
stories.article:
Rajkumar Hirani, one of Bollywood's most celebrated directors, has shared a revealing anecdote about working with Ranbir Kapoor on Sanju — saying the actor arrived for a shoot at 3 am with no entourage whatsoever. The detail, recounted by Hirani and reported by The Indian Express, paints a picture of a star who operates with a quiet, professional intensity rather than the elaborate apparatus typically associated with A-list Bollywood talent.

Sanju, the 2018 biographical film based on the life of Sanjay Dutt, required Kapoor to transform physically and emotionally across multiple decades of Dutt's turbulent life. The film was both a critical and commercial success, and Kapoor's performance was widely regarded as the finest of his career at that point — a verdict that Hirani's anecdote only reinforces.

Hirani's choice to highlight Kapoor's lack of entourage speaks to something specific about how the director values actors on set. For a filmmaker known for ensemble productions requiring long hours and creative discipline, an actor who arrives on time — or before time — and without the friction of a large support team is clearly memorable.

The story has resonated online as a counterpoint to frequent narratives about the demands and excesses of Bollywood stardom. For Ranbir Kapoor, currently in the midst of multiple high-profile productions including the Ramayana, the anecdote reinforces a professional image that has become central to his identity in the industry.
key_facts: Ranbir Kapoor arrived for Sanju shoot at 3 am
Came with no entourage, according to director Rajkumar Hirani
Sanju (2018) was one of Bollywood's biggest hits that year

stories.headline: Ali Fazal calls himself 'imperfect', admits he misses social gatherings in the cinema world
stories.what: Actor Ali Fazal has opened up about his personality, describing himself as 'imperfect' and acknowledging that he tends to miss social gatherings within the film industry. The candid admission offers a glimpse into the quieter side of a star who has navigated both Bollywood and Hollywood, starring in films as well as the internationally acclaimed series Mirzapur. Fazal's self-reflection touches on the social dynamics and networking culture that pervade the entertainment world.
stories.lens: Fazal's frank self-description is a rare moment of candour from an actor who straddles two film industries — and a reminder of how much unspoken social labour goes into sustaining a career in Bollywood.
stories.article:
Ali Fazal has spoken openly about what he calls his 'imperfect' nature, telling The Times of India that he frequently misses social events and gatherings that are a staple of life in the Hindi film industry. The admission is striking from an actor whose career has spanned major Bollywood productions, Hollywood appearances, and the massively popular streaming series Mirzapur.

Fazal's comments touch on a rarely discussed aspect of the entertainment business: the informal social circuit — parties, premieres, and industry gatherings — that often functions as a parallel networking mechanism alongside official professional engagements. His acknowledgement that he misses such gatherings suggests a degree of deliberate or temperamental distance from this world.

The actor described himself as 'imperfect' in a way that reads less like false modesty and more like a considered self-assessment. For someone who has built a reputation for thoughtful, committed performances, the framing aligns with a broader image of an actor who prioritises craft over industry politics.

Fazal, who is also known for his relationship with actor Richa Chadha, has increasingly become one of Bollywood's more reflective public voices. His candour about the social pressures and his own limitations within the industry offers a counterpoint to the carefully managed public personas that most stars maintain.
key_facts: Ali Fazal describes himself as 'imperfect'
Admits to frequently missing social gatherings in the film industry

stories.headline: Creator claims Ramayana makers shared 'nerfed' Lord Ram glimpse for publicity stunt
stories.what: A content creator has publicly claimed that the makers of the upcoming Ramayana film deliberately shared a weakened or 'nerfed' visual glimpse of Lord Ram in order to generate publicity and steer the conversation around the film. The allegation suggests the reveal was a calculated, diluted tease rather than a genuine first look. The Ramayana film, starring Ranbir Kapoor, is one of the most anticipated and expensive Indian productions in recent memory.
stories.lens: If the claim holds weight, it reveals how big-budget Indian mythological films are now engineering public debate as a marketing tool — using fandom expectations and social media outrage as free promotion.
stories.article:
A content creator has sparked online debate by alleging that the producers of the Ramayana film strategically released a deliberately 'nerfed' — or intentionally weakened — depiction of Lord Ram as a publicity manoeuvre. The claim, reported by The Indian Express, implies that the visual shared with the public was not a genuine first look but a calculated, lesser version designed to provoke reaction and keep the film in the news cycle.

The Ramayana project, which stars Ranbir Kapoor in the title role, has been one of the most discussed films in Bollywood for several years, owing to its scale, subject matter, and reported budget. Any visual release related to the film commands enormous attention, making it a prime candidate for controlled, strategic reveals by its marketing team.

The 'nerfed glimpse' allegation fits into a broader pattern of big-ticket Indian films managing their pre-release publicity with precision — releasing partial or softened visuals to test audience response, manage expectations, or simply maintain a presence in the conversation without committing to a full reveal. Whether this was the Ramayana team's intention remains unconfirmed by the producers.

The creator's claim has nonetheless ignited discussion among fans and film observers, with many debating whether the Lord Ram visual shown was consistent with the film's reported ambitions. The episode underscores how intensely scrutinised every decision around the Ramayana project has become, and how much expectation the film must eventually meet.
key_facts: Creator alleges Ramayana makers released a deliberately 'nerfed' Lord Ram visual
Claim suggests the reveal was a publicity stunt, not a genuine first look
Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram

stories.headline: Shah Rukh Khan's 'dream' realized: Knight Riders open Los Angeles cricket stadium
stories.what: Shah Rukh Khan's Knight Riders group has realized what the actor calls a long-held dream with the opening of a cricket stadium in Los Angeles. The facility marks a significant step in the franchise's expansion beyond Indian Premier League cricket and into the American market. The development comes as cricket continues to grow in the United States following the ICC Men's T20 World Cup co-hosted by the US in 2024.
stories.lens: A Bollywood icon building a cricket stadium in Los Angeles signals how seriously Indian entertainment and sports money is betting on cricket's American future.
stories.article:
Shah Rukh Khan's dream of establishing cricket in the United States has taken a concrete shape with the inauguration of a cricket stadium in Los Angeles under the Knight Riders banner. The facility, detailed in a report by The Indian Express, represents the franchise's most ambitious infrastructure investment outside of India and stands as a marker of cricket's growing footprint in North America.

Knight Riders, the group that owns the Kolkata Knight Riders in the IPL, has steadily built a global cricketing empire with franchises in multiple T20 leagues. The Los Angeles stadium is seen as the group's boldest statement yet — a permanent home for cricket on American soil, at a time when the sport is riding a wave of interest in the US market following recent international tournaments held on American grounds.

For Khan, who has spoken publicly about his passion for growing cricket globally, the project carries personal significance. The phrase 'dream realized' underlines how long this vision has been in the making, stretching well beyond the commercial logic of franchise ownership into something the actor and businessman considers a legacy project.

The move also has wider implications for the Indian diaspora in California and cricket fans across the western United States, who have historically had to travel far or watch on screens. A dedicated stadium in Los Angeles could anchor a permanent cricketing culture in one of the world's most prominent cities.
key_facts: Knight Riders open cricket stadium in Los Angeles
Shah Rukh Khan describes it as a personal 'dream' realized
Franchise owns teams across multiple global T20 leagues
